Solution 1 is wrong: $K_4 \subseteq K_5-e$ gives $R(K_5,K_5-e) \ge R(K_5,K_4) = 25$, so 22 is too small. Solution 2 has a valid lower bound of 25 but asserts equality without proof, and I believe the true value is strictly larger. Solution 3 is unsupported, and its claimed value $R(K_5-e,K_5-e)=22$ is inconsistent with the bounds I can check.

CHOICE: NONE
CONFIDENCE: 3
